content_sections.heading: Panjab University Ph.D. Research Fellow at a Glance

rows.details: Kidar Nath Gaind Pharma Research Fellowship (KNGPRF)
Kidar Nath Gaind Pharma Research Fellowship
Rs. 11,000/- per month for two years

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential educational qualifications specified for the position under the supervision of Professor Ranju Bansal in Pharmaceutical Chemistry: B Pharm and M Pharm with a minimum of 55% marks (50% in case of SC/ST/PH candidates). M Pharm degree in related specializations. Qualified GATE, GPAT, Ph.D. Entrance Test, or any National Entrance test exam conducted by any Central Government department. Preference will be given to candidates having good publication records and work experience.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated emolument of Rs. 11,000/- per month for a fixed tenure of two years only. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Panjab University Ph.D. Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Prepare your hard copy application along with a detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV). Submit the application by email to [email protected] or send it by post. Address postal submissions to the office of the Chairperson, University Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences (UIPS), Panjab University, Chandigarh. Ensure your application reaches the office latest by 21st October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection is based on an interview of eligible candidates. The evaluation will be conducted on the basis of marks obtained in B Pharm and M Pharm, GATE/GPAT score, number and quality of publications, presentations, patents, and/or other research accomplishments. The interview will be held on 22 October 2026 at 2:30 PM in the office of Chairperson, UIPS, Panjab University, Chandigarh. Candidates must bring relevant documents to support their application.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Ph.D. Research Fellow position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The position is on a contract basis for a tenure of two years only under the Kidar Nath Gaind Pharma Research Fellowship (KNGPRF).

faq.question: Q2. Who gets a relaxation in the minimum required marks?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to SC, ST, and PH categories receive a relaxation, requiring a minimum of 50% marks in B Pharm and M Pharm instead of the general 55%.

faq.question: Q3. Are there any desirable qualifications specified in the notice?
faq.answer: The notice does not list separate desirable qualifications, but states that preference will be given to candidates having good publication records and work experience.

faq.question: Q4. Which documents are required to be brought for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring relevant documents to support their application, including proof of marks obtained in B Pharm and M Pharm, GATE/GPAT scores, publications, presentations, patents, and other research accomplishments.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.
